text: Wooden stake. The classic vampire-slaying instrument. Driven through the heart to destroy the undead. Works on most standard vampire variants. Ineffective on elder vampires without a follow-up decapitation.
Holy water vial. Blessed water causes severe burns on contact with vampires, demons, and corrupted spirits. Can be thrown or used to consecrate a perimeter. Loses potency after 30 days.
Silver blade. Pure silver edge effective against werewolves, shapeshifters, and certain fae creatures. Causes wounds that resist supernatural healing. Must be at least 92.5% silver to be effective.
Iron salt rounds. Shotgun shells packed with iron filings and sea salt. Disrupts incorporeal entities such as ghosts, wraiths, and shadow beings on contact. Does not permanently destroy them.
Spectral anchor. A carved obsidian disc that pins a ghost or spirit to a fixed location, preventing movement or possession. Must be placed within the spirit's haunt. Effective for 72 hours.
Garlic braid. Dried garlic woven into a protective braid. Repels vampires and certain lesser demons when hung at entry points. Does not harm, only deters. Best used to secure a safe room.
Wolfsbane tincture. Concentrated extract of aconitum. Applied to weapons or used as a perimeter spray to repel and weaken werewolves. Toxic to humans in large doses. Handle with care.
Banishment sigil kit. Pre-drawn sigil templates on treated parchment. Activated by blood or flame to force demonic entities back to their plane of origin. Single use. Includes 5 sigils.

UV emitter grenade. Compact device that emits a burst of ultraviolet light equivalent to direct sunlight. Effective against photosensitive vampires and certain cave-dwelling creatures. 10 meter radius.
Salt circle kit. Coarse sea salt in a dispenser designed for rapid circle deployment. Ghosts, demons, and bound spirits cannot cross an unbroken salt line. Ineffective in wind or rain.
Iron chain bindings. Heavy iron manacles and chain for restraining werewolves during lunar cycles. Iron disrupts shapeshifter transformation partially. Rated for 800 pounds of force.

Exorcism scroll. Handwritten Latin exorcism ritual on consecrated vellum. Reciting aloud forces demonic possession to release its host and expels the entity. Requires 4 minutes of uninterrupted reading.
